title: Research & the Latin American ecosystem
intro: A research-led initiative to help build semiconductor capabilities originating in and owned by Latin America, with an initial focus on Colombia and Peru. This is a long-term, staged ambition — not an existing factory or product.
secdNote: Our proprietary computational research direction, applied to stochastic process and defect modeling. Under active development — not yet independently validated on commercial semiconductor production.
policyIntro: Public policy we track across the region. Status changes — always confirm at the official source.
institutionsIntro: Public universities, agencies and associations active in the regional semiconductor conversation. We track and may seek to engage these — linking them here does not imply any partnership or endorsement.
peruRoadmapIntro: From the APCI multi-stakeholder working group (December 2024 report).
disclaimer: We reference public institutions, programs and legislation to show the ecosystem we are part of and tracking. Links are to primary (government and university) sources and do not imply partnership, endorsement, or affiliation. Legislation and programs change — verify current status at each official link.
ctaText: If you are a university, lab, agency, or company exploring the regional semiconductor ecosystem, we would like to hear from you.
